motion.name: action-transition

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main image check or recovery action.
components.css: .ds-primary{font: 1rem/1.6 system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:2.8rem;border:1px solid var(--accent);border-radius:7px;background:var(--accent);color:white;padding:.65rem 1.2rem;font-weight:650;text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 150ms ease-out,border-color 150ms ease-out;}.ds-primary:hover{background:var(--accent-hover);border-color:var(--accent-hover)}.ds-primary:disabled{background:#647896;border-color:#647896;cursor:wait}.ds-primary:focus-visible,.ds-secondary:focus-visible,.ds-file:focus-visible,.ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:4px;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-primary{transition:none}}

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-secondary{font: 1rem/1.6 system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:2.8rem;border:1px solid var(--accent);border-radius:7px;background:var(--accent);color:white;padding:.65rem 1.2rem;font-weight:650;text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 150ms ease-out,border-color 150ms ease-out;background:var(--surface);color:var(--accent);border-color:var(--line)}.ds-secondary:hover{background:var(--soft-blue)}.ds-primary:focus-visible,.ds-secondary:focus-visible,.ds-file:focus-visible,.ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:4px;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-secondary{transition:none}}

components.name: File Input
components.description: Native image chooser with visible label and help.
components.html: PNG or JPEG · up to the configured limit
components.css: .ds-field{font: 1rem/1.6 system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;color:var(--ink)}.ds-field label{display:block;font-weight:650;margin-bottom:.7rem}.ds-file-wrap{padding:1.25rem;background:#f8faff;border:1px dashed #91a8ce;border-radius:8px}.ds-file{font:inherit;font-size:.9rem;display:block;width:100%;min-width:0;color:var(--ink)}.ds-file::file-selector-button{background:var(--soft-blue);color:var(--accent);border:1px solid #bdcde8;border-radius:6px;padding:.6rem .8rem;margin-right:.7rem;font:inherit;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer}.ds-file::file-selector-button:hover{background:#dce7f9}.ds-field p{font-size:.875rem;color:var(--muted);margin:.7rem 0 0}.ds-primary:focus-visible,.ds-secondary:focus-visible,.ds-file:focus-visible,.ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:4px;}

narrative.overview:
VisionGuard uses a restrained coursework utility world: white content on a cool gray surround, dark blue-gray text, and blue actions. The interface keeps the image check, estimate, recovery path, and saved metadata easy to scan.

Flat panels and fine borders provide structure. Native controls and concise explanations suit the confirmed direct HTML/CSS implementation; uncertainty stays visible beside the result.
keyCharacteristics: Flat white panels and fine rules.
Blue actions with explicit keyboard focus.
Readable native forms and a horizontally scrollable history table.

rules.name: The Action Blue Rule
rules.body: Use blue for actions, current navigation, and the prediction value; use warning and error colors for their corresponding messages.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Separate surfaces with background tone and fine borders; the shipped system uses no box shadows.

dos: Do keep the uncertainty caveat visible with the prediction and confidence.
Do preserve visible focus, the skip link, and semantic form and table labels.
Do let long metadata wrap and let history scroll within its own container.
Do use the established panel, button, and spacing tokens for extensions.
donts: Don't use confidence as proof of image origin.
Don't hide history columns to fit a narrow viewport.
Don't add decorative illustration to this scoped coursework interface.
